description: This file defines a class 'hooks' with a method 'load_js' that handles loading specific JavaScript files and includes based on certain request parameters within a SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment. The method loads social media-related scripts conditionally depending on the module and action specified in the request.

classes.name: hooks
classes.description: A class responsible for handling hook-related actions, specifically loading JavaScript files dynamically based on request parameters in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM environment.

methods.name: load_js
methods.description: Loads social media JavaScript files conditionally based on the 'action' and 'module' request parameters, including mappings for Facebook and Twitter integration.
